commit_message: Restrict native readiness to registered MCP mutations
pr_body: Require NativeAgentRuntime readiness to be proven by Agent Host-recorded successful mutations rather than generic model-loop exchange strings. Planned source work requires a successful managed workspace write event. Planned project work requires a successful host-recorded tool action whose name is present in the canonical Editor MCP descriptor inventory and is classified as mutating, so unrelated host tool actions such as workspace.code_write cannot satisfy project-authoring work. Planned asset work requires managed acquisition or governed MCP mutation evidence. Regression tests cover exchange-only false positives, unrelated host actions, registered read-only MCP actions, and registered mutating MCP actions. The existing NotApplicable source-validation wording fix remains. Logic-only change; Visual Validation is not required.
